title: L-shaped storage bench
summary: A 3 metre storage bench that turns the corner, with three lift-up lids and panelled fronts, built in MDF.
intro: A long wall and a corner that were doing nothing. The bench runs 3 metres along the wall and turns 1.2 metres round the corner, at 400 mm high, so it is a seat and a storage box at once. Three lids lift on hinges, each with a finger hole to open it, and the fronts have a simple raised panel. I drew it in SketchUp first so the client could see the size against the room.
